Guru Nanak Jayanti 2026 Interior Design project planning in Hyderabad

Consider inclusive shared areas and durable, low-maintenance finishes for a welcoming home.

Considering modular kitchens, wardrobes, living rooms, false ceilings and turnkey home interiors? This Guru Nanak Jayanti season is an opportunity to organize ideas into an actionable brief, rather than rush into materials or pricing before the project requirements are clear.

An interior-design proposal should start with the floor plan and room-wise needs: modular kitchens, wardrobes, living-room storage, lighting, false ceilings, work areas and installation constraints. Choose materials, hardware and finishes only after reviewing usage, budget and maintenance needs.

Ideas to take from the Guru Nanak Jayanti season

Consider inclusive shared areas and durable, low-maintenance finishes for a welcoming home. The best result comes from matching these ideas to the actual property dimensions, local conditions and everyday routines.

  • Plan room by room: Start with kitchen, wardrobes, living spaces and practical storage.
  • Choose materials deliberately: Compare plywood grades, finishes, hardware and lighting before execution.
  • Know what is included: Review room-wise BOQ, drawings, installation scope and agreed timelines.

Checklist before asking for a Guru Nanak Jayanti quote

  1. Identify the property type, city, room sizes and possession or renovation timeline.
  2. Prioritize the kitchen, wardrobes, living areas, lighting and storage needs.
  3. Choose finish and hardware preferences with drawings and item-wise specifications.
  4. Request a room-wise proposal, installation milestones, clear exclusions and warranty terms.
